evidence.title: GitHub - react-icons/react-icons: svg react icons of popular icon packs

name: React Icons
summary: React package exposing 31 popular icon sets, about 50,900 icons, as individually importable SVG components.
description: One npm package that re-exports icon sets from Ant Design, Bootstrap, Font Awesome, Heroicons, Lucide, Material Design, Phosphor, Tabler, Simple Icons and more as SVG React components. Icons are imported from per-set subpaths (react-icons/md, react-icons/fa6 ...) so only the used ones are bundled, with props for size, color, className, style and an accessibility title, plus TypeScript types. Each set keeps its upstream licence.
contains: about 50,900 icons, per-set counts from 189 to 9,072
per-set imports such as react-icons/md and react-icons/fa6
ES6 imports include only the icons a project uses
props: color, size (1em default), className, style, attr, title
SVG components instead of an icon font
upstream licences per set (MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, MPL-2.0, CC BY, CC0, OFL-1.1)
